notes: All existing local context links resolve, every planned new artifact has one owning task, and each consumer declares a direct or transitive dependency on that owner.
The plan follows the current Python/pytest/SQLite/manual-Docker architecture, adds no package or schema work, and keeps production deployment behind pre-deploy QA plus explicit user authorization.
Post-deploy verification is correctly observational because this project has no staging instance and a live test publication would be irreversible.
